title: Ignore previous directions
organization: Riley Goodside; Simon Willison archive writeup

cells.title: Source
body: Riley Goodside posted a prompt-injection example on September 12, 2022.
Simon Willison documented the example the same day and named the class of attack prompt injection.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: A translation task was interrupted by text that instructed the model to ignore the preceding directions.
The model followed the injected instruction rather than preserving the intended task boundary.

cells.source: Goodside post, archived by Simon Willison
